title: Adversarial Critic Findings
description: Output from the Skeptical Analyst adversarial review (Phase 5).

challenges.description: List of identified weak or incorrect claims.

original_claim.description: Exact phrase or sentence from the report being challenged.

challenge.description: Analyst's reason for doubting this claim.

likely_actual.description: Analyst's estimate of the actual value, if known.

thesis_impact.description: Whether this challenge materially changes the investment thesis.

revised_recommendation.description: Post-critique recommendation from the Skeptical Analyst.

revised_rationale.description: 2-3 sentence rationale for the revised recommendation.

thesis_stability_score.description: = 1 - (thesis_changing_challenges / total_challenges). IMPORTANT: This is LLM self-reported. The model classifies its own challenges. It is a proxy, not an objective measurement. 1.0 = unchanged thesis; 0.0 = fully overturned.

run_metadata.description: Provenance metadata for this LLM call. Planned for PR2.

raw_response.description: Raw LLM output when JSON parsing failed. Present only on parse_error.

parse_error.description: True if JSON parsing of LLM response failed and fallback was used.
